**File: `x-pack/qa/repository-old-versions-compatibility/src/javaRestTest/java/org/elasticsearch/oldrepos/TestSnapshotCases.java`**

**Line 16:** `public static final String ES_VERSION_6 = "5";` — should be `"6"`

**Line 19:** `public static final String ES_VERSION_6_STANDARD_TOKEN_FILTER = "5_custom_analyzer";` — should be `"6_custom_analyzer"`

**Failure scenario:** The comments state these are for "Index created in vES_6" but the values are copied from the vES_5 constants. This causes all four version-6 test classes (`RestoreFromVersion6IT`, `RestoreFromVersion6CustomAnalyzerIT`, `MountFromVersion6IT`, `MountFromVersion6CustomAnalyzerIT`) to incorrectly use version-5 snapshot zips (`snapshot_v5.zip` and `snapshot_v5_custom_analyzer.zip`) instead of the intended version-6 snapshots. The version-6 backward-compatibility tests would silently test the wrong snapshots.
